method: Independent code did not import the regional implementation. Source manifests reconstructed; all 24 prediction states rebuilt with scaler and coefficients; all point metrics and category recall recomputed; one source-only colour pipeline independently refitted across complete 7-by-5 search and Platt/Youden. Four bootstrap weight arrays independently regenerated; all 100 intervals and 60 paired contrasts recomputed with an independent pairwise AUC formula and checked against sklearn.

bootstrap_audit.independent_auc_formula: Explicit weighted positive-negative concordance with half credit for ties; no import of implementation or its sorted cumulative algorithm.

inference_limits: Post hoc analysis within an already examined archive, not a new independently acquired cohort.
Known regions are recovered search-index associations; timestamp-derived UTC days are not verified plant, farm, plot or capture identities.
227 unknown-region images are excluded from both training and test; exclusion depends on source label.
Centre-Ouest strict training has zero virosis and only 15 Alternaria-labelled images; regional results combine spatial, temporal, training-budget and source-label-case-mix changes.
Selected-C OOF probabilities fit calibration/threshold and are not unbiased internal validation scores.
Bootstrap intervals condition on fixed models and these three observed regions; no retraining, new-region or biological-replication uncertainty.
Region-only versus day-purged comparison changes training budget and composition; it is not an isolated causal leakage effect.
Generic minimum_region is a literal numerical minimum. Only higher-is-better metrics such as BA identify a worse region; minimum Brier denotes the best Brier.
Original folder labels were preserved; no new expert pathology or laboratory review was performed.
